gen_risks.description: Delays in project implementation due to inadequate financial management staff
gen_risks.mitigation: Hire additional financial management staff and provide training to ensure adequate capacity
Develop a comprehensive procurement plan and provide training to procurement staff

gen_risks.description: Climate-related disasters affecting project implementation and education outcomes
gen_risks.mitigation: Integrate climate-resilient design principles into school construction and develop emergency response plans
Provide comprehensive teacher training and mentoring programs
Develop a community engagement plan and establish a grievance redress mechanism

gen_risks.description: Inadequate monitoring and evaluation of project outcomes
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive monitoring and evaluation plan and establish a data management system

gen_risks.description: Delays in disbursement due to inadequate financial reporting
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a financial reporting plan and provide training to financial staff

gen_risks.description: Inadequate school infrastructure and learning environment
gen_risks.mitigation: Construct and rehabilitate school buildings and provide necessary facilities and equipment

gen_risks.description: Inadequate human resource management and capacity building
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a human resource management plan and provide training and capacity building programs

gen_risks.description: External factors affecting project implementation, such as political instability or economic crisis
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a risk management plan and establish relationships with key stakeholders

gt_risks.description: Environment and Social risk is rated Substantial due to (a) limited institutional capacity to manage environmental and social risks and impacts; (b) nationwide implementation of the project's activities; (c) possible exclusion of vulnerable groups (such as poor children, children with disabilities, and indigenous groups); and (d) other risks involving child protection, occupational health and safety, labor issues, and sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (SEA/SH).
gt_risks.mitigation: The project will develop a capacity-building plan for the Environmental and Social Safeguards Office and Project Management Unit, including hiring dedicated environmental and social specialists and providing targeted training. It will establish robust monitoring mechanisms to ensure support for vulnerable groups (universal design in new school/WASH construction, materials adapted for visually impaired students), strict adherence to worker codes of conduct, complaint redress and referral mechanisms, and construction site safety measures to protect school children and communities from labor influx and construction-related risks.
